name: The Changing Of Seasons
overview: Scripture reveals that God sovereignly governs the changing of seasons, establishing a divinely appointed order for seedtime and harvest, night and day, and the cycles of summer and winter as a perpetual ordinance (Genesis 8:22; Psalms 104:19). Life itself unfolds within these appointed times, each with its purpose under heaven, from birth to death and planting to harvesting (Ecclesiastes 3:1-2). Though the full scope of God's work in these seasons is beyond human comprehension, He makes all things beautiful in their time and holds our days securely in His hand (Ecclesiastes 3:11; Psalms 31:15).
